$comment: Pose table for build_agent.bpy: per pose, per bone, degrees about the ARMATURE axes (X right, -Y front, Z up), applied at the bone head. Rest: arms hang 30 degrees out from vertical, head level. arm_l is the figure's left (+X, the viewer's right), arm_r its right (-X). Each pose is one action keyed on frames 1 and 12.
